summary: zero-baileys@3.6.0: static keyword co-occurrence in messages-media utility, no traced installer harm
details: zero-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. A pattern rule fired on lib/Utils/messages-media.js where require("child_process"), https.request, hostname, and POST tokens co-occur in the file. These primitives are expected in a WhatsApp protocol library that uploads/downloads media over HTTPS and shells out for media processing (ffmpeg/ImageMagick). No specific installer-side secret read, no hardcoded exfiltration destination, and no install-time or import-time execution path has been identified in this record. The package name shares a prefix with the widely used @whiskeysockets/baileys library and should be treated with care as a fork of unknown provenance, but no concrete installer-attack behavior is substantiated here.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
